name: appmixer.ai.agentcore.InvokeAgentRuntime
description: Invoke an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and receive the aggregated (buffered) response.
author: Appmixer <info@appmixer.com>

agentRuntimeArn.label: Agent Runtime ARN
agentRuntimeArn.tooltip: The ARN (or agent ID) of the AgentCore Runtime to invoke.

runtimeSessionId.label: Runtime Session ID
runtimeSessionId.tooltip: Session identifier used to maintain conversation state. Must be 33-256 characters long.

payload.label: Payload
payload.tooltip: The request payload sent to the agent runtime. Usually a JSON object matching the content type, e.g. {"prompt": "Hello"}.

qualifier.label: Qualifier (Endpoint)
qualifier.tooltip: Optional endpoint name pointing to a specific version. Defaults to the runtime's DEFAULT endpoint.

runtimeUserId.label: Runtime User ID
runtimeUserId.tooltip: Optional user identifier. Requires the additional bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntimeForUser IAM permission.

contentType.label: Content Type
contentType.tooltip: MIME type of the payload. Defaults to application/json.

accept.label: Accept
accept.tooltip: Desired MIME type of the response. Defaults to application/json.

response.title: Response
response.example: {"result":"Hello, how can I help you today?"}

example.result: Hello, how can I help you today?
